reasoning.decision: Pinterest video pin, 1000×1500, 12–35s, hook by 1s, sound off
reasoning.because: People are planning, not scrolling: idea-led, calm and save-worthy, worded like what they searched for. Muted, looping, slow; a hard sell reads as an ad and loses the save.

reasoning.decision: Personal Finance Companion: $49 (list $99), motif "index", calm personality, cool accent #0d3b2e
reasoning.because: From its definition and Shop listing. 4 real screens to show.

reasoning.because: Teaches from the guide first; Personal Finance Companion is the product the guide hands over to. 3 lists and timelines, 5 questions to draw from.

reasoning.because: Nobody knows Draftpace yet, so films show how it helps with real moments. Who it is not for, questions before buying, what you get and the price wait until there are users to sell to.

reasoning.decision: Allowed real lines up to 4 words longer
reasoning.because: Every structure Personal Finance Companion's copy supports at Pinterest video pin's normal line length is already used by its other films; a longer real line beats telling the same story twice.

reasoning.decision: Do this: Open on the search itself, then the guide's own numbered steps, then the product.

Search-led: "financial binder what to include", answered by 4 of the guide's numbered steps ("A ten minute starting path").

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab.
Camera "float": a gentle float that keeps a held frame alive without demanding attention.
Grounds ink → light → light → accent: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Pinterest video pin (0.32s a word), inside 12–35s.
